questions.question: A wave has a frequency of 4 Hz and a wavelength of 3 m. Determine its speed and explain the calculation.
questions.reference_answer: Use wave speed = frequency times wavelength. The speed is 12 metres per second.

criteria.description: States or uses speed = frequency times wavelength.
Obtains 12 m/s with a speed unit. Equivalent units are acceptable.

questions.question: A loudspeaker doubles the frequency of a sound in the same air. What happens to its period and why?
questions.reference_answer: The period halves because period and frequency are reciprocals.

criteria.description: Explains the inverse relation between frequency and period.
